summary: BHP Group Limited furnished a Form 6-K containing an ASX Appendix 3Y Change of Director's Interest Notice dated 10 November 2026 for director Brandon Craig, disclosing a change dated 5 November 2026. The notice records the grant of 169,723 share rights for nil consideration — 116,353 long-term incentive performance rights plus 26,685 deferred rights vesting in two years and 26,685 vesting in five years — alongside his prior holdings of 63,360 ordinary shares and existing incentive awards. This is a routine director-interest disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction terms, board recommendation or advisor applies.
